name: SCOUT
size_range: Small totes to XX-large zip totes
notes: Store meta: SCOUT Bags, Washington, DC, USD, ships to the US only; 'SCOUT Bags are designed for life. Featuring collectable patterns, our life-proof fabrics are always durable, never dull' (https://scoutbags.com/meta.json). Sold by 'hundreds of independent retailers nationwide' plus Destination Stores (https://scoutbags.com/pages/the-scout-story); not its own stores, so us_stores left empty.

Free shipping on orders $99+ (https://scoutbags.com/policies/shipping-policy). Returns postmarked within 30 days of delivery, unused with hang tags; $3 per item restocking fee at Return Bar locations (https://scoutbags.com/policies/refund-policy).

Named: Original Deano Tote Large $55 ('OUR BEST-SELLING BAG SINCE 2004', open-top tote), Original Deano Tote Small $39, Uptown Pocket Tote $49 (four large outside pockets, 16 x 12 x 5.5 in.), Bagette Market Tote $35 ('holds 2x as much as typical grocery bags'), Miss Manors Tote $99.

Mix of the 13 regular-price bags counted (2026-10-29): 12 totes (tote, pocket tote, extra-large tote, market tote) and 1 crossbody (Emily Crossbody $65); no backpack among them. Uptown Pocket Tote copy: 'a popular pick for moms, teachers, students, and nurses' (https://scoutbags.com/collections/bags/products.json?limit=250).

prices.note: https://scoutbags.com/collections/bags/products.json feed, 33 listings: 5 marked down and 0 sold out excluded, 15 out-of-scope items excluded; 13 regular-price bags, median $65. Low / mid / high: Bagette Market Tote $35; Rocket Pocket Tote $65; Miss Manors Tote $99. Like-for-like: carry bags at regular price, in stock (totes, shoulder and crossbody bags, satchels, hobos, belt/hip bags, backpacks); luggage, duffels and weekenders, lunch bags, diaper/baby bags, pouches, wallets, wristlets, cosmetic cases, straps, charms, coolers, pet and kids' items excluded.
